name: Data developed by Tyndale House up to 2021
body:
Tyndale House, Cambridge UK [TyndaleHouse.com](http://www.TyndaleHouse.com) commissioned and supported the STEPBible project financially and with their scholarly expertise. When they encouraged STEPBible.org to become an independent Charitable Incorporated Organisation, their official involvement with data development ceased. This Release is the state of the data soon after that time, when the names of datasets were changed from **Tyndale...** to **Translators...**   
Any issues with this data should therefore be reported to STEPBibleATgmail.com, and not to Tyndale House.
